description: Pulse Wave 6.1.11 — Flagship Upgrade: DJ Crossfade Transitions, Smart Sleep Timer 60s Fade-Out, Lossless Audio Badges, Pulse Connect Remote Control, One-Tap Smart Cache, and Vinyl Turntable Widgets.

changelog.title: Audiophile & Playback Polish
items: DJ Blend Crossfade: Enabled by default with smooth 4s gapless transitions between tracks for continuous Spotify and Apple Music style flow.
Smart Sleep Timer Gentle Fade-Out: Over the final 60 seconds (or half remaining time), music volume smoothly dims across 30 micro-steps from 100% to silent before pausing, ensuring peaceful sleep.
Audio Stream & Codec Badges: Lossless FLAC, 320k Opus, and AAC badges displayed cleanly alongside sleep timer countdown with instant access to full stream metadata.

changelog.title: Pulse Connect & Listening Delights
items: Pulse Connect Remote Control: Control your PulseWave Desktop PC app right from your phone over local Wi-Fi (Play/Pause, Skip Next/Prev, and live Volume slider).
Pulse Wrapped & Stats: Reconnected in-app listening statistics route to review your top artists, tracks, and listening milestones.
Apple Music Syllable Karaoke Lyrics: Kinetic word-by-word active glow and smooth gradient animations active out-of-the-box.

changelog.title: Smart Offline & Data Saving
items: One-Tap Smart Cache: Instant one-tap button in Storage Settings to pre-cache all your liked songs in the background for offline listening.
Visual Storage Breakdown: Monitor exact space occupied by downloaded songs, streaming audio cache, and album art.

changelog.title: Android Home Screen Widgets
items: Vinyl Record Turntable Widget: Authentic high-fidelity turntable with album art label, vinyl rim, concentric audio grooves, and center spindle hole.
Status Bar Waveform Visualizer: Razor-sharp audio frequency pulse wave in notifications.
